summary.overallStatus: real production-shaped monorepo with strong implementation and human-in-the-loop governance

implemented: Monorepo structure with web app, worker, shared core, db, render, and UI packages
Dashboard, queue, inbox, accounts, onboarding, and operator tooling
OAuth flows and platform-specific adapter architecture
Real background worker with scheduler and job registry
Publish pipeline with duplicate prevention and kill switch
AI generation pipeline and prompt system
DB-backed content lifecycle with ideas, content_items, hooks, series, and campaigns
Routing, account identity confirmation, and product/persona safety
Attribution, link tracking, and app-store attribution model
partial: Live platform posting requires valid credentials, account review, and platform compliance
Draft-only/manual-publish paths are implemented but not fully autonomous
Some platform-specific capabilities are intentionally gated by API restrictions
plannedOrUnprovenInCode: Fully autonomous social-media operation without human approval
A complete platform-agnostic no-human-signoff rollout across every network

keyFindings: The repo contains a working social operations system, not a mock or placeholder project.
Content moves through a queue and approval model rather than auto-publishing without review.
The system explicitly enforces duplicate publish protection and routing safety.
Platform live publishing is gated by OAuth setup, account review, API permissions, and account state.
The architecture is designed to automate drafting and orchestration while leaving final approval and compliance in the operator path.
